attributes.residual: 18 lines, ONE named mechanism plus its downstream colouring. Target builds the effect pointer as `mulli r0,r25,240; add r27,r26,r0; addi r27,r27,2976` (base+index first, constant last); ours builds it as `mulli r3,r25,240; addi r22,r3,2976; add r22,r26,r22` (constant folded into the scaled-index addend). MECHANISM: MWCC's front end reassociates p + i*K + C to p + (i*K + C) and discards the source's written associativity whenever the intermediate `base + i*K` pointer has exactly ONE use; the add-then-addi form survives only when that intermediate is read at a second site first. Positive control proving the mechanism, same TU, byte-exact: StartMagicHealFX reads `node = ((EffectPage*)e)->fx[0].node;` (lwz at 2996 off the PRE-offset pointer) between the two steps and keeps the target form; the same idiom transplanted into StartBlockFX in this session converted that function's identical cluster and moved it STRUCTURAL -> REGISTER_ONLY. fn_80093BC0's target has NO second use of the pre-offset pointer, so the lever is unavailable and the remaining 14 lines are the r27-vs-r22/r23 renaming downstream of it. NOT WEBFRANK-READY: the two streams differ in actual instructions (add vs addi with different operands), not in schedule or colour, so neither the permutation nor the register stage applies.
